pros: It is an effective project management tool; with the proper setup and structure, it will enable your team to remain on top of all pending tasks and hold each other accountable for all areas of the job. Our team has gained more visibility into our operations and projects thanks to the platform's customizability and automations to promote efficiency. We reduced the need to communicate outside of ClikcUp (for example, via email), which boosted visibility into the status of multiple activities while lowering the need to hunt for communications pertinent to a certain work.
cons: ClickUp has numerous capabilities, the drawback to usually that it takes a parcel to memorize best hones, how to set up the framework, and how to adjust your business and work fashion to the ClickUp framework. There are a couple of bugs related to automations and repeating errands that we have experienced, be that as it may ClickUp back group have been exceptionally supportive in settling these issues.
general_comments: ClickUp addressed our project management issues, assisted our teams in staying on top of projects, assisted our managers in staying on top of individuals and their duties, and provided everyone on our team with visibility into what was going on, who was accountable for what, and how far we had to go to attain the end objective. We replaced the excel file with ClickUp to handle our yearly financial report process; our configuration in ClickUp is comparable to other workflow tools in that we can appoint a preparer, reviewer, and so on using the custom fields. When the status of a task changes, for example, from preparation to review, the automations transfer it to whoever is the reviewer on that job.

review_title: Powerful All-in-One Productivity Tool with a Steep Learning Curve
pros: ClickUp is unique in that it can be customized and is quite adaptable. With tools like goal-setting, job management, and time tracking integrated into a single platform, you can customize your workplace to meet the unique needs of your team in a unique manner. Keep everything in one place with ease thanks to the smooth interactions with other programs like Zoom, Google Drive, and Slack. The scalability of the platform is remarkable, supporting both small and large teams. Additionally beautifully designed, the mobile app successfully replicates the desktop experience.
cons: Even newcomers might find the wide range of features overwhelming. It takes time to get the hang of setting up your workspace in the best way. The interface packs a punch, but it can look cluttered at times, and some of the fancy tools aren't always easy to use. Now and then, you might run into slowdowns or loading issues that throw you off your game. Also, while the support team is quick to respond, they could do a better job of solving tricky problems.

reasons_for_switching: Other product was old fashioned, not up to day with modern needs. Every option we wanted to add was not part of the basic feature and required professional support etc.Clickup is a one-stop-shop for all your CRM needs and integrates with all you other software!
